definitions.explanation: A request for information, typically addressed to a company, organization, or authority.
The act of getting in touch with someone for information or assistance.

examples.japanese: {電話|でんわ}で{問|と}い{合|あ}わせる。
{在庫|ざいこ}について{問|と}い{合|あ}わせた。
examples.english: I inquired about the stock availability.

examples.japanese: ご{不明|ふめい}な{点|てん}がございましたらお{問|と}い{合|あ}わせください。
examples.english: Please contact us if you have any questions.

examples.japanese: {お問|おと}い{合|あ}わせ{先|さき}はこちらです。
{お問|おと}い{合|あ}わせフォームから{送信|そうしん}してください。
examples.english: Please submit through the contact form.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}たくさんの{問|と}い{合|あ}わせが{届|とど}くので、{返信|へんしん}に{時間|じかん}が{掛|か}かることがある。
examples.english: Many inquiries come in every day, so replies can sometimes take time.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a noun or with する to form a verb.
- {問|と}い{合|あ}わせる: to inquire, to contact
- {問|と}い{合|あ}わせをする: to make an inquiry

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- お{問|と}い{合|あ}わせ: inquiry (polite, often seen in business contexts)
- お{問|と}い{合|あ}わせ{先|さき}: contact information
- お{問|と}い{合|あ}わせ{窓口|まどぐち}: inquiry counter/desk
- お{問|と}い{合|あ}わせフォーム: contact form

BUSINESS CONTEXT:
- Websites often have an 「お{問|と}い{合|あ}わせ」 page for customer inquiries
- Customer service departments handle {問|と}い{合|あ}わせ{対応|たいおう}

POLITENESS:
The お prefix is almost always used in business and formal contexts.
